body:
MCP 2026-07-28: **Other schema change 1, PR 2710** ([changelog](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog)).

## Now
The spec's own schema was corrected. mike's numeric parameters have not been audited against what the server accepts.

## Change in mike-mcp
- Audit `integer`, `number`, `minimum`, `maximum` and `default`.

## Scope
Every numeric parameter of all 131 tools and every elicitation field.

## Done when
- [ ] A test compares each numeric schema with the type and limits the server accepts, and names any mismatch.

## Always
- The existing `mike` channel registration, `claude/channel` capability and `notifications/claude/channel` delivery work as they do today on 2025-11-25 and earlier connections.
- Every existing tool keeps its name, arguments and profile membership.
- The end state holds in a real Claude Code session, as well as in tests.
title: mike-mcp: Tool schemas state integer and number correctly
